Class UniversityStudent

java.lang.Object
Student
UniversityStudent
public class UniversityStudent extends Student
Concrete implementation of a Student representing a university student in the Longhorn Network. This class extends the abstract Student class and implements the connection strength calculation algorithm.
Version:
1.0
Author:
LonghornNetwork Team

  • Method Details

    • calculateConnectionStrength

      public int calculateConnectionStrength(Student other)
      Calculates the connection strength between this student and another student. The connection strength is calculated based on the following criteria: - Roommate: Add 4 if they are roommates - Shared Internships: Add 3 for each shared internship - Same Major: Add 2 if they share the same major - Same Age: Add 1 if they are the same age
      Specified by:
      calculateConnectionStrength in class Student
      Parameters:
      other - The other student to calculate connection strength with
      Returns:
      An integer representing the connection strength (0 or higher)
